cases.sentence: В девятом году, в ___ десятого месяца , было ко мне слово Господа:
cases.explain: «десятый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.sentence: В девятом году, в десятый день ___ , было ко мне слово Господа:
cases.explain: «десятого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.sentence: — Сын человеческий, запиши этот день, ___, потому что царь Вавилона в этот день осадил Иерусалим.
cases.explain: «сегодняшний день» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

cases.explain: «мятежному дому» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

cases.explain: «хорошее мясо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.

cases.sentence: Не снимай ___ и сандалии, не закрывай нижнюю часть лица и не ешь пищу плакальщиков.
cases.explain: «головной убор» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

cases.sentence: На головах у вас будут ___, а на ногах — сандалии.
cases.explain: «головные повязки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
